title: launching a subagent-tier build alone is rejected (dry run), naming the build and the tier
source: intended: docs/decisions.md (a subagent-tier build is not launchable alone with jitso launch)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-5, tiers; docs/decisions.md, owner 2026-11-15). The build `plan` has `tier: subagent`, so `launch --build plan` is rejected by validation: exit 2, one stderr line `JITSO REJECTED: ...` that names the build and the tier, nothing on stdout, nothing written, no registry line, orca never called. The TS binary does not know tiers: it treats plan as a normal approved build, so the dry run exits 0 and prints a card (exit, stdout and stderr expectations FAIL on TS).
